verdict.rationale: Notte supports 'traditional scripting' alongside AI actions and lets users 'deploy your scripts as API endpoints' with scheduling, and references 'generated workflow code' from observe() calls — implying some ability to build reusable, parameterized automations beyond one-shot prompts. However, there is no explicit documentation of loop constructs, conditional branching, or parameter templating within these workflows, and most product framing (docs-18, gh-1) emphasizes single natural-language prompts rather than structured workflow composition. Missing for 10: explicit loop/conditional syntax, parameterization examples, and independent confirmation that scripted workflows are reliably repeatable in practice.
